semiconductor_relevance: High — IntekPlus specializes in vision inspection and non-contact measurement solutions specifically for the semiconductor and display industries.
summary: IntekPlus Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of advanced inspection and metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on 2D/3D vision inspection technologies. Their equipment is designed to detect defects and improve product quality during manufacturing processes such as wafer inspection and semiconductor packaging.

regional_presence.Korea: IntekPlus is based in South Korea and focuses on providing solutions to semiconductor and display manufacturers globally.
